title: WIP: Collet's interior affine moment in the detector count gives 0.8748436 (Lean proof incomplete)
description: Work in progress; the Lean proof is incomplete and contains explicit sorry. Mechanism: Hailey Collet's interior affine moment (cycle61 manuscript, Theorem 2.2, PR #42) is used on the tracker only for the numerator; it also covers the detector count's critical plain witness (plain length about 0.418, slot width 0.036-0.040, inside the theorem's window), giving slot capacity min(1/25, (B-2m)/lambda) for plain lengths m in [41/100, 264/625] instead of (1-2m)/(6 kappa). With Zhongpai Gao's constants (PR #43, q0 = 67/100) and h = 497/625 this certifies theta = 2187109/2500000 exactly (top row 199 + 8 Bernstein boxes, old rows 6 + 1). The arithmetic layer (closed-form count, region gates, four-branch count lemma, record-point gates) is formalized; the integration into the cycle61 source is not yet. Prepared with AI assistance (Claude) for liqsweep; Collet's, Gao's and OpenAI's attribution and Apache-2.0 notices retained.
